Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Tanay - 9 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Meenakshi - 39 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The road - a paved road, trees along it
3. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Tanay stands in the courtyard. Meenakshi stands near him.]

Meenakshi: "What lovely weather!"

[Tanay sings a song.]

Tanay: "This is amazing!"

[Tanay whispers something to Mother.]

Tanay: "Mom, are you okay?"

Scene 2: The road - Day

Tanay: "Let's begin."

[Tanay rides his bicycle down the road.]

Tanay (laughing): "That was fun!"

[Tanay gets into the car.]

Tanay (gently): "That's easy."

[Tanay gets on the bus.]

Meenakshi: "Careful!"

[Tanay gets off the school bus.]

Meenakshi: "Tanay, are you okay?"

[Tanay hops into an auto-rickshaw.]

Tanay (surprised): "What next?"

[Tanay pedals his bicycle hard up the road.]

Tanay (excited): "What next?"

Scene 3: The living room - Day

[Tanay stands in the living room. Meenakshi stands near him.]

Meenakshi: "Tanay, look over here."

[Tanay eats his breakfast at the table.]

Tanay (softly): "Listen!"

[Tanay gulps down a glass of milk.]

Tanay (excited): "That was fun!"

[Tanay sweeps the floor with a broom.]

Tanay: "What next?"

[Tanay irons his school shirt.]

Tanay: "This is amazing!"

[Tanay reads a storybook.]

Meenakshi (surprised): "Good job, Tanay!"

[Tanay does his homework at the table.]

Meenakshi: "Well done!"

Scene 4: The courtyard - Day

[Thick fog lies all around. Tanay stands in the courtyard. Meenakshi stands near him.]

Meenakshi: "Let's begin."

[The mist slowly clears.]

Tanay (laughing): "I really enjoyed today."
